title: evidence.nu: checkpoint grep pattern never matched run subjects
description:
Adopt from run 01M0NA4J5H30CZAFZEBF7HHQX5 (implementer checkpoint 23f073160).

Painpoint (planner@3 diagnosis): the checkpoint-base detection grepped for
'fabro.<run-id>:' but real checkpoint subjects are 'fabro(<run-id>):' —
zero matches, so the base fell back to HEAD and every evidence capture in
that run rendered empty diffs ('NO RUN BASE'). The reviewer correctly
rejected twice on missing evidence.

Fix (already on the product run branch): match the subject with
--fixed-strings on a derived subject mark instead of the broken pattern.
Port that evidence.nu into this branch's canonical copy under
.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/.

Acceptance: .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu uses the
fixed-strings subject match; nu-check passes; platform gate green.

title: qualitygate: go build must not recreate artifacts in the worktree
description:
Adopt from run 01M0NA4J5H30CZAFZEBF7HHQX5.

Painpoint: 'go build ./...' in the product qualitygate recreates the gofib
binary inside the worktree on every gate run, so the gate leaves the tree
dirty and reviewers flag artifacts the implementer never committed.

Fix (already on the product run branch): build into a temp directory
OUTSIDE the worktree (go build -o into an OS temp dir). On this platform
branch the canonical scripts/ tree holds only workflow tooling; this seed
exists so the convention is recorded platform-side: gates never write
build outputs into the worktree. Document the rule in the workflow's
implementer prompt if not already present.

Acceptance: no platform or product gate step writes artifacts into the
worktree; convention documented; platform gate green.

title: evidence: reorder sections so tail-truncation cannot hide the verdict-critical parts
description:
Adopt from run 01M0NA4J5H30CZAFZEBF7HHQX5.

Painpoint: the harness capture keeps only the tail of long command output
(~26 of 60 lines observed). evidence.nu printed the diff early and seed
specs last, so the 'NO RUN BASE' marker and tracker state were cut off and
the reviewer judged on a truncated tail.

Fix (already on the product run branch): order sections so the cheap,
verdict-critical parts come first — tracker state, in-progress seed specs,
changed-file stat, working tree — and the long diff last; keep sections
slim so typical captures fit. Port the reordering into this branch's
canonical copy.

Acceptance: evidence.nu emits tracker/spec sections before the diff;
nu-check passes; platform gate green.

title: Bake pinned toolchain into fabro-runner:mise (kill 24.5s mise install per run)
description:
## Problem

Every run's setup spends ~24.5s of ~32s in 'mise install' (run
01M0NJZGX7BMJAJC3CZJZ0RNT0, run-12 review). The runner image is lean by
design; the toolchain is declared per-branch via .mise.toml and
bootstrapped per run.

## Fix

Extend .fabro/Dockerfile.mise (recipe exists on the denkhaus branch) to
bake the PINNED tools of both worlds into the image.

Layer plan (docker layer caching = idempotent, only changed layers
rebuild):
1. base: ubuntu:24.04 + bash/git/ca-certs/curl/xz + mise (existing)
2. product tools: bun 1.4.0, go 1.27.0, just 1.58.0, nushell 0.115.0
3. platform tools: fabro v0.333.0-nightly.0 (ubi), uv latest
4. npm CLIs: bun install -g @os-eco/seeds-cli@0.5.15
   @os-eco/mulch-cli@0.10.7

Add a justfile recipe on meta:
  bake-runner: docker build -f .fabro/Dockerfile.mise -t
  fabro-runner:mise .
(+ optional --pull). Document: run after pin bumps; docker layer cache
makes it seconds when nothing changed.

[run.prepare] stays as-is (mise install becomes a no-op verification
when versions match the image; bootstrap still checks tool health) —
the image is an optimization, not a new failure mode.

Engine-side companion: fabro-969f on denkhaus (docker provider
auto-build from image.dockerfile).

## Acceptance

- Dockerfile.mise builds clean locally (docker build)
- new image passes: just bootstrap && just qualitygate in a container
  probe (both worlds)
- a run using the baked image shows setup < 10s in run events
- bake-runner recipe + doc comment in .mise.toml noting the pairing

## UPGRADED URGENCY (2026-08-23, runs 01M0QDMSDRZQ/01M0QFC53P6D/01M0QFX511V5)

Three failed runs: aqua-backend installs (lefthook 2.0.x/2.1.x, betterleaks
cosign-bundle) fetch the Sigstore TUF repo from run sandboxes and fail
(curl reaches sigstore fine from the same net — mise-side); additionally
unauthenticated GitHub-API rate limits (60/h per IP) throttle mise
installs, and GITHUB_TOKEN deliberately does NOT reach the sandbox env
(token only in the git credential helper — correct architecture, so no
token path to mise).

Interim state (denkhaus-lab e200ca17e+8683cfa7f): lefthook AND
betterleaks temporarily removed from .mise.toml (only lefthook.yml's
pre-commit used them; no run-path dependency). Restore both by baking
the pinned toolchain into fabro-runner:mise — this seed now removes the
mise-install class of run failures entirely (rate limits, sigstore,
24.5s setup cost).

title: evidence: survive summary:high stage-renderer tail_lines cap (119 lines omitted hid the seed-work diff)
description:
Adopt from run 01M0NTS5XCXJ4V88M9MQWKD83G (analysis complete).

## Root cause (two truncation layers)

Layer 1 (OURS, working): evidence.nu self-budgets to 6.8k chars — the
output itself was complete and in-budget.

Layer 2 (ENGINE, the killer): summary:high's per-stage section renders
command output via tail_lines(...) — the reviewer's prompt received the
evidence section as '(119 lines omitted)' + tail, hiding the integrity
header and the ENTIRE main.go diff. Second cycle: 144 lines omitted,
identical rejection. The tool-less reviewer correctly refused to approve
invisible evidence twice; planner@3 correctly escalated Blocked (cycle
guard worked); seed fabro-8d26 remains open though code is verified.

## Fix (workflow side, within our control)

The evidence capture must fit the RENDERED budget, not the raw output
budget: tail_lines appears to keep ~the last N lines and drop the head —
exactly where our critical-first sections live.

1. Measure the effective rendered cap empirically (prompt #3 evidence
   section: ~119+visible lines -> derive chars).
2. Rearchitect evidence.nu: the reviewer's verdict-critical material is
   the DIFF — emit it FIRST inside command.output (tail_lines keeps the
   tail... so instead: emit ONLY a compact integrity header + diff
   tail-budgeted to the renderer's window, dropping our own nice-to-have
   sections) OR move review to a node that renders full output.
3. Engine-side (companion on denkhaus, update fabro-9467/fabro-e47c):
   per-node preamble scoping lets the reviewer see ONLY the evidence —
   no other stages, no renderer caps on the one input that matters.

## Acceptance

- a run whose seed-work diff is ~120 lines reaches the reviewer FULLY
  rendered (no 'omitted' inside the evidence section)
- reviewer approves a green-gate pass on visible evidence in one cycle
- fabro-8d26 (verified correct) closes on the next run

title: planner painpoint claims must be verified — deliver via context relay, not stated files
description:
Adopt from run 01M0NTS5XCXJ4V88M9MQWKD83G.

## Failure

Planner@3's response claimed 'both painpoints are recorded in
/workspace/fabro/.fabro/run-painpoints.jsonl and mirrored below' — the
tool history shows only two `cat` reads (second: file missing), ZERO
write calls. The staged file never existed; the refiner correctly
delivered nothing; the two genuinely valuable painpoints (evidence
truncation, deadlock diagnosis) were lost with only prose remnants in
the run log.

## Fix (workflow side)

The prompt contract says 'append one JSON line to the staged file' —
the model claims the action without performing it (classic unverified
claim). Options:

1. planner.md: mandate an explicit verify step — after writing, `cat`
   the staged file and quote its line count in the response; the
   reviewer-side check: response claims must cite file line counts.
2. Stronger (engine, fabro-176b already filed): post-stage hook appends
   declared painpoints deterministically — no LLM relay to trust.
3. Short-term deterministic: a tiny pre-refiner command node that
   extracts painpoints from context.workflow_painpoints into the staged
   file (context is engine-verified, unlike claimed file writes).

Option 3 removes the trust gap without engine changes: implement as
`stage-painpoints.nu` between planner and refiner? Evaluate during
implementation; option 1 is the 5-minute stopgap.

## Acceptance

- a run ending with painpoint claims delivers matching rows to the
  mailbox (verifiable in painpoints.jsonl)
- planner responses that claim file writes without performing them are
  caught (verify-step or deterministic relay)

## LINK (2026-08-23): message-bus seed fabro-meta-8652

The trust failure documented here (planner claiming unwritten painpoint
files) is failure class 1 of three relay failures; the message-bus
concept replaces the LLM relay entirely (message_send tool with
engine-added sender provenance).

title: Message bus: targeted message_send between stages (replaces last-writer-wins context relay)
description:
## Concept (from lab run 01M0QJ5FNE9 evidence)

Targeted messages between stages, NOT one shared context key that every
agent must faithfully restate.

## API

- Agent stages: tool `message_send(target, message)`
  - target: node id ('reviewer', 'planner', 'refiner', or a well-known
    mailbox like 'painpoints' / 'platform')
  - message: plain text (or JSON line) — bounded per message (e.g. 2KB)
  - the engine adds the SENDER stage id to the payload internally —
    provenance is structural, not claimed
- Deterministic stages (command nodes): a first-class command
  (`fabro message send ...` or nu script helper) with the same
  semantics — no LLM in the loop
- Delivery: messages addressed to stage X are injected into X's input
  (preamble section '## Messages' or equivalent) at X's next visit;
  messages to a mailbox are delivered by the refiner deterministically

## Why (three failures of the current relay, all observed)

1. TRUST: last-writer-wins requires each agent to restate the FULL
   accumulated list error-free; anything forgotten is silently deleted
   (fabro-meta-b3aa: planner claimed file writes that never happened)
2. GROWTH: the accumulated key grows per cycle (measured: 1.6KB -> 2.1KB
   in one run) — every cycle re-reads all history in every preamble,
   the exact accumulation the preamble budget exists to prevent
3. SABOTAGE: that growth pushed the 6.6KB evidence capture over the
   12KB aggregate budget, demoting it to a blobref the (tool-capable)
   reviewer was never told it could read — a full review cycle burned
   on delivery failure (run 01M0QJ5FNE9, reviewer painpoint)

## Design constraints

- messages are append-only per run; bounded per message; NOT context
  keys (no budget interaction, no restate requirement)
- sender provenance added by the engine, unforgeable by the agent
- persistence: same seam as checkpoints (durable across resume) —
  candidates: run event stream (already durable) + materialized file
  (.fabro/messages.jsonl) for agent pull
- reading side: addressed messages render into the target's prompt
  (## Messages section, after preamble scoping); pull access via a
  read tool can follow later (fabro-e804 family)
- supersedes the relay mechanics in fabro-176b (painpoint capture
  becomes message_send to the 'painpoints' mailbox; the refiner
  delivers from the message store, not from a context key)
- validation: lint unknown target node ids (warning, like
  preamble_stages_ignore)

## Open questions (design round needed)

- exact injection point (preamble section vs system message)
- per-mailbox message caps (unbounded painpoints mailbox = same growth
  problem one level up? likely: cap per sender per run)
- do parallel branches inherit the parent's messages?

## RESOLVED WITHOUT BUILDING (2026-08-23): hooks replace the bus

Grilled outcome: no message bus. The ONLY observed failure is the
N-writer painpoint accumulation; 1:1 handoffs over context keys work
correctly (last-writer-wins is RIGHT for 1:1). The StageComplete hook
(fabro-176b work item 2: extend HookContext with context_updates)
captures painpoints deterministically post-stage and routes them to the
mailbox — engine-added provenance for free (the hook knows node_id),
no restate relay, no new message store, no budget interaction.

Generalization if ever needed: targeted context keys (for.<node>.*)
rendered only at the target via existing scoping — not a bus.

Existing engine assets inventoried during this round (for any future
messaging work): SteeringHub (live human->agent, bounded queues),
Pairs (per-stage chat protocol, 8KB cap, idempotent, agent tool
access), node_outcomes provenance (structural, unexposed).

title: develop: stale-base awareness after publish_blocked runs (unmerged run-branch remediation)
description:
## Context

fabro-67e5 landed on the platform (denkhaus 7d4176995): a green graph whose
publish failed now terminates as succeeded(publish_blocked) with a
PublishFailed failure detail and remediation text; Slack sees run.completed
(not run.failed). The workflow side (graph, prompts, notifications config)
needed no structural change — verified 2026-08-25 against meta/denkhaus-lab.

## Problem

With auto_merge enabled, a publish_blocked run means NO PR was created (or
push failed entirely), so the run branch fabro/run/<id> holds work that will
never merge back. The NEXT run clones the stale base:

- the planner may re-implement work that already sits on an unmerged run
  branch (its verification-only path only fires when acceptance criteria
  happen to look satisfied in the stale worktree)
- nothing in the loop (prepare, evidence, closeout) surfaces that the base
  is behind unmerged run branches
- the Slack remediation is the only signal; nobody acts on it autonomously

## Candidate directions (decide together)

1. prepare step: detect unmerged fabro/run/* branches ahead of base and
   fail fast / annotate context (cheap git, deterministic)
2. closeout: when tracker_empty routes to exit, check for unmerged run
   branches and surface them in the terminal context
3. evidence: include 'branches ahead of base' in the capture so the
   reviewer/planner can see them
4. accept as-is: Slack is the human signal; document the manual remediation
   (open PR from fabro/run/<id>) as the run branch being the durability path

## Acceptance

- decision recorded (ADR or seed note) on which direction(s) ship
- if 1-3 ship: deterministic, no LLM, tested against a run branch ahead
  of base

title: Fix invalid reasoning_effort pin on planner node
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro (planner node, line 29) change reasoning_effort="medium" to "low" or remove the node-level pin — glm-5.3 only allows low/high/max. Run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E died 1.5s into the planner stage with invalid_request: model 'glm-5.3' does not support reasoning_effort 'medium' (0 tokens, will_retry=false), failing the run with 0 of 4 seeds touched. Expected effect: the planner's first LLM call succeeds and this exact failure class becomes impossible.

title: Validate node-level model controls at submit time
description: Extend .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/sync-check.nu (or the engine submit path) to cross-check node attrs like reasoning_effort against the resolved provider/model capabilities before sandbox creation. In run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E the error was purely static (graph pins medium, provider allows low/high/max) but was only discovered after 33.4s of sandbox + setup. Expected effect: config-class errors fail in under 1s with the provider's exact message instead of a ~51s run costing a sandbox and a pushed branch.

title: Surface root-cause error in terminal run status
description: In the engine's conclusion mapping (or by dropping goal_gate=true on the planner node in workflow.fabro, since planner failure already has an explicit edge to refiner), make the terminal failure reason the original signature planner|…|invalid_request instead of 'goal gate unsatisfied for node planner and no retry target'. In run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E the visible status masked the actual model-control rejection, which lived only in stage detail. Expected effect: run lists show an actionable root cause in seconds.

title: Scope skill discovery to workflow skills dir
description: Scope skill source dirs per workflow/node in agent settings to .fabro/skills, dropping /storage/.home/skills for the develop workflow. Run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E's agent.skills.discovered event pulled 36 skills (personal ones like ask-matt, scaffold-exercises) into a planner that only needs sd, adding discovery time and prompt bloat against a tight preamble_budget_kb=12. Expected effect: smaller preambles, less role-prompt distraction, and removal of the skill-token crash class the prompts defensively work around.

title: Skip empty checkpoint commits on failed runs
description: In the engine checkpoint path, skip commit/push when the stage diff is empty and the run has no retry target. After the planner failed (0 tokens, 0 files changed), run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E still spent ~14s on two meta snapshots, two empty commits (dfb266e, d99a357) and two remote pushes — over half the workflow wall time, producing only branch pollution. Expected effect: failed runs terminate within ~2s of their terminal stage with no empty commits to clean up.

title: Raise reviewer preamble budget from 12KB to 20-24KB
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro line 6, raise preamble_budget_kb from 12 to 20-24, and correct the now-false 'carries the evidence capture in full' claims at workflow.fabro lines 79-84 and prompts/reviewer.md line 11. In this run two ~6.4KB evidence captures exceeded the 12KB budget and spilled to ~400-char previews, so reviewer@2 approved without ever seeing the diff; the resulting no-op rework cycle cost $0.209 and ~5 min (32% of the run).

title: Add planner->refiner Blocked edge and output variant
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, add a planner -> refiner [label="Blocked"] edge (planner exits are lines 127-129; Blocked exists only on implementer->planner at line 132) and add a Blocked output variant (outcome: succeeded, label Blocked, failure_reason in context) to the outcome contract in prompts/planner.md. In this run planner@4 routed preferred_next_label="Blocked", the missing edge tripped the goal gate, and the run concluded workflow_error despite seed fabro-8d26 being implemented, gated green, and approved.

title: Mark seed fabro-d810 blocked-external with infeasibility facts
description: In the seed tracker, fix seed fabro-d810 (in .seeds/issues.jsonl via sd): add the dependency on the denkhaus fabro-29f7 rebuild sequence or drop its priority below implementable seeds and label it blocked-external, and paste the infeasibility facts (which fabro not found, no run-event store under .fabro/, no meta world) into the seed description. In this run planner@1 and planner@4 re-derived the known-dead state (~$0.26, ~7 min, 35% of the run) while sd ready still lists it priority-1 with zero blockers.

title: Add Evidence retry verdict to reviewer
description: Add a third route ("Evidence retry": outcome: succeeded, preferred_next_label: "Evidence retry") to prompts/reviewer.md (lines 30-60 offer only Approved and Changes requested) plus a reviewer -> evidence [label="Evidence retry"] edge in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro. In this run reviewer@1 explicitly wanted only an evidence re-run but had to route changes_requested, forcing a full no-op pipeline cycle ($0.21, ~5 min) over a byte-identical diff.

title: Remove tool-less contradiction from reviewer prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md line 13, delete the "re-run just qualitygate yourself — you have tools" clause and state instead that gate results are visible only via the tester stage section; the node is shape=tab (tool-less) and the reviewer's own painpoint in this run flags exactly this contradiction.

title: Restrict verification-only briefs to smoke-level commands
description: Add one sentence to prompts/planner.md verification-only guidance: "list smoke-level commands only (go build, go test, go run smokes); the gate belongs to the tester stage." In this run planner@2 and planner@3 briefs mandated just qualitygate under Required verification commands while implementer.md rule 4 forbids running the full gate, forcing implementer@3 to resolve the contradiction itself (painpoint #3 in .fabro/run-painpoints.jsonl).

title: Require English responses in implementer prompt
description: Add "Always respond in English" to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md. In this run implementer@2 replied in German ("Verstanden — ich beende den Run…") to a German stop steer, and that reply leaked into later stages' context.

title: Stop restating the full painpoint list in every prompt
description: Change the painpoint sections in prompts/planner.md, prompts/implementer.md, and prompts/reviewer.md to emit only NEW entries appended directly to the append-only .fabro/run-painpoints.jsonl (which refiner.nu already delivers from), dropping the restate-the-full-accumulated-list instruction. In this run ~2.8KB was mirrored into three prompts per pass and the reviewer received the list truncated — accumulation lossy at exactly the node told to restate it; also frees preamble budget to compound with the budget raise.

title: Projectize prime boilerplate with the real gate in AGENTS.md
description: In run 01M0QTNF6GWHGPKHSQ2Y2PB8CQ, planner@1 and implementer@1 each ran sd prime/ml prime and ingested ~5 KB of generic template including a close-protocol demanding bun test && bun run lint && bun run typecheck — commands that do not exist in this Go repo, whose gate is just qualitygate. Add a project-override note in AGENTS.md outside the tool-generated seeds-onboard markers: this repo's close protocol is just qualitygate, and bun-based prime instructions do not apply. Expected effect: removes wrong-stack misexecution risk and stops contradictory context in every agent stage.

title: Skip PR creation when the run diff is journal-only
description: In .fabro/project.toml [run.pull_request], skip PR creation when the diff excluding .fabro/journal/ is empty. Run 01M0SFEYVC9TD6MP816RHEBFQY verified its goal (6 of 6 seeds closed, 'Tracker empty' exit) with an 18-line journal-only diff, yet attempted a PR with auto_merge = true, hit a deterministic 403, and flipped to failed(publish_failed) — same 403 noted in the 01M0T9B7T6 review at project.toml line 74. Effect: no-op runs report success instead of failed, and no squash-merged journal churn into the base branch.

title: Convert reviewer to agent node with read-only tools
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, convert the reviewer from a prompt node to an agent node with read-only tools (read/glob/grep) so blob-ref'd evidence captures are readable. Complements the preamble-budget raise in fabro-83f9. Evidence: run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q reviewer@1 rejected green gate-passed work it could not read and reviewer@2 approved blind; the workaround cycle burned $0.112 of $0.257 (43%) for zero code change.

title: Stop re-rendering every past cycle in preambles
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, render only the latest visit of command stages in reviewer/implementer preambles and clear consumed context keys (review_feedback, review_verdict, stale implementation_summary) after the planner handles them. Run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q preambles grew 12.4KB to 21.9KB across cycles, blowing the 12KB budget; with max_visits=20 cycle 5+ would be unreadable.

title: Treat branch-pushed-PR-failed as completed-with-publish-warning
description: In the publish step of .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, add a pre-run PR-scope credential check in prepare and downgrade 'branch pushed, PR creation failed' (403 after PR-body JSON parse failure in run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q) to a retryable publish-warning instead of failed(publish_failed). Also fix the PR-body JSON contract for glm-5.3 that the deterministic fallback masked. Effect: run status reflects loop outcome — that run closed seed fabro-e6df and pushed 13 commits yet reads as failed.

title: Cap evidence flowing through context updates in planner and implementer prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md and implementer.md, cap context-update summaries (~500 chars; evidence belongs in the capture or repo, never in context_updates) and remove the inline-report workaround instruction once the reviewer evidence pipe is fixed. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q the inlined implementation_summary grew to 2.6KB and itself blob-offloaded, worsening the preamble budget problem.

title: Bake ripgrep into the runner image
description: Add ripgrep to the runner dockerfile toolset (one apt-get/mise line in settings.environment.image.dockerfile). In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q planner@1 hit 'command not found' for rg, got empty native grep results on main.go twice, and fell back to find/head — about 5 wasted exploration calls per planner pass.

title: Write only non-empty stage journals
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/stage-journal.nu, either populate data (e.g., with the stage painpoints) or skip writing when empty. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q the stage-journal hook wrote 13 identical {"data": {}} files into every checkpoint diff, inflating the loop churn the evidence script reports (10 files +82/-1).

title: Skip metadata snapshots on non-agent stages
description: Skip checkpoint metadata snapshots for non-agent command stages (tester/evidence) in the checkpoint hook configuration of .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q snapshots ran ~1.8-2.3s at all 13 checkpoints (~25s total) — free wall-time trim with no evidence loss on those stages.

title: Prioritize source files and enlarge diff budget in evidence capture
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, sort seed files code-first (source before docs) before the whole-file diff walk — line 229 currently sorts alphabetically so README.md (~1.3 KB) consumed the ~2 KB allowance — and raise OUTPUT_BUDGET from 6800 to ~7600 by trimming SPEC_CAP (2200). Evidence: run 01M0T2GW0PTNF3CHNQKHER1271 budget cut omitted 2 of 3 seed-work diffs (main.go, fib_test.go) while keeping the README, forcing the reviewer to recover them via git diff. Effect: reviewer verifies from the capture directly; no tool-recovery detour.

title: Lint develop seeds for spec contradictions before tracker entry
description: Add a contradiction check at seed creation (where fabro-4f3e-style seeds are authored) comparing the spec's examples against pinned behavior in README/CONTEXT.md. Evidence: seed text said -start 'Default 0' while gofib's 1-based indexing is pinned by README/CONTEXT/tests; planner@1 burned 102.5 s inference and /bin/bash.067 deliberating it (~40% of planner time). Effect: ~1.5 min and ~/bin/bash.05 saved per ambiguous seed, one less source of reviewer ping-pong.

title: Compute pipeline progress from unique completed nodes
description: In the engine's progress projection, compute progress as unique completed non-meta nodes / total instead of cumulative stage completions against a fixed node denominator. Evidence: run 01M0T2GW0PTNF3CHNQKHER1271 implementer prompt read '0 of 5 stages completed' after the planner had completed; final projection said '6 of 5' because planner ran twice. Effect: honest, interpretable mid-loop progress numbers.

title: Cap reviewer re-verification to capture-only judging
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md add a verification-economy clause: judge from the evidence capture; use tools only for claims the capture cannot show; never re-run a check whose exact assertion already appears in the diff. In the analyzed run reviewer@1 spent 61.0s of 62.2s active time re-running build, go test, go vet and README reproduction already pinned by exact-string test assertions and a green tester stage, finding zero discrepancies. Expected effect: review cycle ~62s down to ~35-40s, ~$0.02 saved per seed.

title: Whitelist implementer smoke checks and make spec re-fetch conditional
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md (a) replace 'a quick smoke check is fine' with a hard whitelist (build + affected test package only; never just qualitygate) and (b) make the step-1 sd show fetch conditional on a thin or ambiguous brief. In the analyzed run implementer@1 was 48% of run cost, ran the full gate plus live CLI checks later re-verified by tester@1, and its first tool call re-fetched the spec the planner had just distilled because step 1 mandates it while the Input section declares the brief authoritative. Expected effect: ~25-40% off implementer inference (~30-45s, ~$0.03 per seed) and the brief-versus-spec authority ambiguity disappears.

title: Give the evidence node its own output context key
description: Key the evidence command node to evidence.output instead of command.output, via command-node keying in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro and scripts/evidence.nu. In the analyzed run tester wrote the gate log (checkpoint seq 199) and evidence silently overwrote it (seq 209) because both nodes share one key; the reviewer prompt already papers over the clobber, so it only failed to bite because everything was green. Expected effect: no last-writer-wins overwrite; on a red-gate bounce the gate result stays readable from context.

title: Add a review_notes channel for non-blocking findings
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md and planner.md: Approved JSON gains optional context_updates.review_notes; the planner folds them into a future brief or parks them as a low-priority polish seed. In the analyzed run the reviewer's only substantive observation (pretty branch calls Fib(seed) twice; a local var would suffice) was lost at approval because it was explicitly not a deviation and the painpoint channel covers loop friction only. Expected effect: non-blocking hygiene findings accumulate into one tractable cleanup seed instead of evaporating.

title: Forbid brief duplication and empty-tracker double checks in planner
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md make the closing rule absolute (prose must not repeat the brief; routing rationale only) and move the sd-list restriction into the decision order (sd ready empty with nothing in progress means route Tracker empty; do not run sd list). In the analyzed run planner@1 emitted the full 1.5KB brief twice, carried through every checkpoint, and planner@2 ran sd list --format json after sd ready had already returned nothing. Expected effect: about 1.5KB less carried context per cycle and one turn (~5s) off every terminal planner pass.

title: Render verification report only in implementer JSON summary
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, state the per-criterion PASS/FAIL report lives only in the JSON implementation_summary and pre-JSON text stays one short paragraph. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K the implementer duplicated the report as markdown prose plus verbatim JSON (8,024 of 10,693 output tokens; implementer was 60% of run cost at $0.213 of $0.353), and both copies were re-read as preamble by reviewer and planner. Expected effect: ~10-15% lower run cost and smaller downstream preambles.

title: Add deterministic post-approval seed-close node
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, insert a command node on the reviewer Approved edge that closes the seed, checks sd ready, and routes empty-tracker to exit vs seeds-remaining to planner (Changes requested still routes straight to planner). In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K planner@2 only mechanically closed fabro-8208 and listed an empty tracker (14.8s, $0.016 of LLM work). Expected effect: one fewer LLM visit per seed cycle and no misparse risk on the tracker-critical path.

title: Include gate stdout tail in evidence capture
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, append the quality gate's small stdout tail to the evidence integrity header. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K tester@1 output was 288 bytes yet reached the reviewer only as a blob ref, and the reviewer prompt explicitly excludes gate output, so reviewer@1 re-verified live (six re-runs, 97.5s, 25% of run cost). Expected effect: removes the reviewer's main excuse for tool re-verification and shrinks the Verification-blocked failure class.

title: Raise develop preamble budget to 20 KB
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, raise graph attr preamble_budget_kb from 12 to about 20 (input shrinkage from the implementer-output fix helps for free). Worker logs for run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K show the preamble budget exceeded even after demotion at four consecutive prompts (up to 18,053 bytes vs 12,288 budget), firing blob-ref demotion every cycle. Expected effect: fewer blob-ref round-trips (each costs a reviewer tool call plus turn) and no per-cycle budget warnings. Related to existing seed fabro-83f9 (reviewer node scope); this one covers the graph-wide budget.

title: Add sd syntax cheat-sheet and call-order rule to planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, document exact write syntax (sd update <id> --status in_progress, sd close <id>, no --format on writes) and instruct sd ready first with sd list only when ready is empty or blockers matter. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K planner@1 wasted a call on sd update --format json (unknown option error, event seq 62-63) and ran redundant parallel sd ready and sd list on a one-seed tracker. Expected effect: 1-2 fewer tool calls and one fewer LLM round-trip per planning visit.

title: Gate implementer sd show re-fetch on brief quality
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, make the sd show re-read conditional: only when the brief is thin, ambiguous, or verification-only. In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K the prompt called the brief authoritative yet numbered step 1 ordered re-reading the seed, and the implementer obeyed (event seq 94-98), risking re-import of ambiguity the planner had settled (raw seed Default: no limit vs the brief's pinned 0-sentinel). Expected effect: one fewer call and turn per cycle, planner's resolved reading stays authoritative. Overlaps partially with fabro-a67f (spec re-fetch conditional) but targets the sd seed re-read specifically.

title: Diff evidence against the last seed boundary, not the run base
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, diff against the commit the previous closeout produced (record that SHA as the per-seed base) and raise preamble_budget_kb in .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro to ~48. Evidence captures compounded from 18.1 KB to 38.5 KB in run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 because they diffed against run base de65cd6, forcing reviewers into a blob detour to read the full diff. Expected effect: constant ~18 KB per-seed captures judged inline, zero blob detours, structurally removing preview-only review.

title: Clear transient context keys in closeout
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/closeout.nu, after closing the seed emit context updates resetting review_verdict, review_feedback, and implementation_summary to empty string; then delete the stale-verdict compensation paragraph from .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4, seed 1 review_verdict approved survived into planner@2, implementer@2, reviewer@2, and the exit checkpoint. Expected effect: stale-verdict ambiguity eliminated structurally instead of by prose guard.

title: Make the painpoint channel mandatory-output
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, implementer.md, and reviewer.md, require a painpoints array (possibly empty) in every outcome JSON. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 both reviewers performed the exact friction the channel exists to capture (the blob detour) yet emitted zero painpoints, so the improve loop got no data from a run with real friction. Expected effect: friction lands in .fabro/journal/ on the run where it happened, feeding the improve loop with evidence.

title: Cite acceptance bullets in implementer verification, don't restate them
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, require each PASS line to reference the brief bullet number (e.g. PASS (3)) instead of quoting the criterion, and cap prose before the JSON at 3 sentences. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4, implementer@2 restated all 10 acceptance criteria in full, driving 186 s inference and 0.281 USD (47 percent of run cost). Expected effect: roughly 1.5-2.5k fewer output tokens per pass plus smaller reviewer preambles.

title: Enforce one edit per file path per tool batch
description: Add one line to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md: at most one edit per file path per tool batch; sequence dependent edits across batches. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 the worker log showed 3 concurrent-write-to-same-file-in-one-batch serializing warnings for main.go, README.md, and fib_test.go. Expected effect: eliminates the write-lock warnings and the silent-ordering hazard they signal, at zero cost.

title: Tighten planner sd call economy
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, make the rule conditional and checkable (sd list only if sd ready output is truncated or lacks needed blocker info) and add sd ready --format json to the command table. In run 01M0TXPX09279433MGWSWPVVP4 planner@1 ran sd ready then sd list with byte-identical ~3.3 KB payloads, and used a --format flag on ready not listed in the table. Expected effect: one fewer tracker call and ~10 s less deliberation per cycle while keeping the no-invented-flags rule credible.

title: Require timeout_ms on compile/test shells and ban placeholder appends in implementer prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md ('Your job this pass') add two hard rules: (a) any shell call that compiles or tests MUST pass timeout_ms of at least 60000 — run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's chained append+gofmt+vet+test died at the default 10s with zero output (seq 163-164, 10,345ms, is_error), forcing a blind re-run; (b) never append placeholder code to fix later — the implementer appended a mangled placeholder test via heredoc, then head -n -28 cut the wrong lines leaving a dangling comment, costing ~48s and ~6 wasted calls (a third of its 149.5s stage). Expected effect: implementer pass ~100s instead of ~150s and the silent-timeout failure class eliminated.

title: Fix PR postlude: disable auto-merge and stop the failing PR-body model call
description: In the run-spec pull_request block (see .fabro/project.toml [run.pull_request]) set auto_merge=false — the auto-merge GraphQL call deterministically fails ('Auto merge is not allowed for this repository') despite auto_merge=true — and fix or disable the PR-body LLM call, which failed ('No object generated: Failed to parse response as JSON', worker log 16:44:33 in run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7) and fell back to a skeleton. The postlude burned ~53s after the exit node finished (16:43:46 to 16:44:39), 18% of the 293s wall, and emits two warn-level failures every run. Expected effect: run completes ~50s sooner with two fewer recurring warnings. Partial overlap with open fabro-9f97 (journal-only-diff case); this covers real-diff runs.

title: Make implementer journal report errored or timed-out tool calls
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md (Journal section) add: a tool call that errored or timed out ALWAYS goes in observations, even when recovered — name the call, the timeout, and the workaround. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's implementer journaled observations as none (seq 187) despite a 10.3s shell timeout, an is_error grep, and a signature change forcing edits at ~28 test call-sites; the signal reached the improve loop only via event-stream archaeology. Complements open fabro-b809 (mandatory painpoints array). Expected effect: friction self-reports on the run where it happens, so prompt fixes surface through the journal pipeline instead of manual analysis.

title: Raise preamble_budget_kb from 24 to 32 — evidence blob detour persists
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro (graph attr, currently 24 after the 12-to-24 raise) set preamble_budget_kb=32. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's 22.1KB evidence capture (seq 209) still rendered as a blob ref in the reviewer prompt (seq 218) because 22.9KB + tester section + context keys (~28KB aggregate) exceeds 24KB; the reviewer recovered via one 102ms read_file, but the same detour produced the false rejection in run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q. Expected effect: evidence arrives inline in the preamble, one fewer tool round-trip per review, preview-misread mode removed. SUPERSEDES the targets of open seeds fabro-83f9 and fabro-35ab (both still say raise from 12) — close or amend those to avoid triple filing.

title: Fast-path planner to sd show when the goal names a seed id
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 1 add: if the goal names a seed id, run sd show <id> directly; run sd ready only when it doesn't, and never run sd list to re-confirm a count sd ready already printed. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's goal named fabro-f74b; sd ready returned exactly that one seed (seq 39), yet the planner still ran sd list --format json purely to double-check the count (reasoning at seq 67), after sd show + sd update + two globs + a full 10.4KB read of main.go — 7 tool calls and 76.6s inference for a single-candidate claim. Expected effect: two fewer shell calls and one LLM turn on named-seed runs, the common case for this workflow's goals. Overlaps the tracker-empty case in open fabro-b382 and fabro-e4fa; this covers the named-seed case.

title: Derive files_touched from the stage git diff, not write-tool calls
description: Engine-side: compute stage files_touched from the stage checkpoint's git diff (the data already exists per checkpoint, seq 194 of run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7). That run's implementer metadata reported files_touched: [README.md, main.go] (seq 190) while the actual stage diff — and the evidence capture — shows fib_test.go at +159/-28, the largest product change of the run, missed because the file was edited through shell (perl, head, heredoc append) invisible to write-tool instrumentation. Expected effect: accurate per-stage change attribution with no silently missing files for any consumer keying on files_touched.

title: Classify evidence-pipe workarounds as painpoints in develop stage prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md and implementer.md (Journal section), add one sentence: a successful workaround of the evidence pipe, tools, or scripts is a painpoint with its fix idea, not an observation. In run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V every stage emitted painpoints: [] while the blob-truncation fallback, the per-seed-base idea, and the missing python3/node were logged under observations, where the improve loop that keys on painpoints may never act on them. Orthogonal to open seed fabro-b809 (channel emission, not content classification). Expected effect: genuine fixes reach the improve loop journal on the run where they happen.

title: Tell develop reviewer to read blob refs with read_file offset/limit
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md (Input section, blob-ref paragraph), state that blob files are read with read_file (offset/limit for large blobs). reviewer@3 in run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V found python3/node unavailable and improvised nu str substring chunking on a 58.1 KB evidence blob because the prompt never mentions the sanctioned path. Expected effect: removes improvised-read friction; pairs with open seeds fabro-8d2c/fabro-d97b.

title: Require ml record for implementer near-miss tool lessons
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 6 (or the stage-journal hook), make ml record mandatory for near-miss tool lessons. implementer@1's edit_file old_string swallowed a whole test loop body in fib_test.go, was caught only by re-reading, and the lesson went into the run journal that no future session loads; implementer@2 then spent 284 s / 0.49 USD (42% of run agent cost) editing the same 1,100-line table-literal file without the guardrail. Expected effect: the next implementer inherits the scoped-old_string guardrail via ml prime --files.

title: Declare lesson_capture in the implementer node's context_allow_keys
description: Seed fabro-f831 makes lesson_capture a required key of the Implemented JSON in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, but workflow.fabro's implementer node still declares context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,journal, so the undeclared key drops as drift on every future pass (per fabro-900e comment). Change: one line in workflow.fabro implementer node — context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,lesson_capture,journal; optionally also add it to the reviewer's preamble_allow_keys. Effect: the enforced record-or-skip answer lands durably instead of being discarded.

title: Add a repo-layout map to the planner prompt or AGENTS.md
description: planner@1 burned 354.7 s / $0.219 of the $0.547 total (50,460 input tokens) on ~10 exploratory calls just to locate dev-loop assets that live at .fabro/workflows/develop/ in the same repo; planner@2 with the layout in context took 98 s / $0.064. Change: add a 5-line Repo layout section to AGENTS.md (loaded as memory into every stage) or .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md: gofib at repo root; dev-loop assets at .fabro/workflows/develop/; reviews at .fabro/reviews/; journals at .fabro/journal/. Effect: first planner pass drops from ~6 min toward ~100 s — roughly −4.5 min wall and −$0.15 per run. Distinct from the sd call-economy seeds (fabro-e4fa/f4cd/1399): those tune tracker calls, this removes filesystem orientation calls.

title: Emit a loop-work diff in evidence.nu when only churn files changed
description: Seeds targeting .fabro/ paths are classified as loop churn by .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, so captures read seed-work=0 files +0/-0 and reviewers must run their own git diff. Change: in evidence.nu, when seed_rows is empty but churn_rows is not, emit the per-seed (claim-base) diff of changed loop files under a loop-work diff section — the per-seed diff-base machinery from fabro-1e9f's theme already provides the base. Effect: reviews of dev-loop seeds verify from context, removing the per-review git detour. Cross-ref: fabro-1e9f (diff against last seed boundary) is the same machinery at run level.

title: Ban sd prime in develop planner and implementer prompts
description: planner@1 executed sd prime because AGENTS.md memory instructs it, pulling a 4.7 KB banner whose Session Close Protocol mandates sd close + sd sync && git push — both reserved for the deterministic Closeout; the planner journaled that an LLM skimming the banner could comply. Change: one line in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md and prompts/implementer.md: never run sd prime in this loop — its close/push protocol contradicts the role rules and the context brief supersedes it. Effect: removes a directly contradicting instruction from every stage context and eliminates the mis-close/push risk. Complements the AGENTS.md boilerplate fix in fabro-cc23.

title: Make the authorized-exception pattern standing in the implementer prompt
description: Briefs carry manual override prose (fabro-f831's brief opened with CONTRADICTION RESOLVED authorizing exactly one .fabro/ file), and implementer@2 journaled that the pattern recurred across fabro-7e44 and fabro-f831 and deserves a platform-level convention. Change: in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md's Platform scope section add: exception — a brief that names a specific platform file authorizes editing exactly that file. Effect: planner briefs shed roughly a third of their text and the implementer no longer reconciles a contradiction before starting.

title: Require null-path exercises when editing workflow scripts
description: implementer@1 found a latent crash — a string-typed Nushell param rejects runtime null, which would have crashed evidence.nu's no-seed-in-progress path (mulch mx-0b966a) — surfaced only because that brief happened to demand fallback/null/empty-diff exercises; the gate's nu-check is syntax-only. Change: add to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 2: when editing workflow scripts, exercise the null/no-seed/fallback paths via nu -c before finishing. Effect: rarely-hit paths get verified on every workflow-script seed, not only when a brief remembers to ask.

title: Path-scope the tester gate for prompt-only seeds
description: Both tester runs executed the full Go gate (build/vet/test, 11.1 s cold, 1.1 s cached) on a tree where gofib was never touched — both seeds changed only .fabro/ and .mulch/ files. Change: route a lite path (e.g. a just qualitygate-lite running nu-check + sync) from the same tester node when only .fabro//.md files changed. Effect: seconds per cycle, and a structurally meaningless check disappears from dev-loop seeds; lowest impact of this run's findings.

title: Add evidence to the reviewer's preamble_stages_ignore
description: reviewer@2's prompt carried the identical ~2 KB evidence capture twice plus two tester sections and the prior cycle's closeout block, because preamble_stages_ignore keeps tester+evidence per visit and command.output dedups into the evidence stage section rather than replacing it. Change: in workflow.fabro, add evidence to the reviewer node's preamble_stages_ignore — the current capture still arrives via the command.output context key, which the prompt already teaches the reviewer to read as a blob ref. Effect: ~2 KB less preamble per review cycle and stale prior-cycle captures disappear. Complements open fabro-699f (latest-visit rendering) with a different mechanism.

title: develop planner: close the ## Context input contract (preamble_allow_keys) — implementer already closed
description:
Counterpart to the implementer fix landed 2026-09-03 on denkhaus-lab (commit 9a3131945, synced to this branch in 1c231a039): the implementer node now has preamble_allow_keys = the seed trio, so the planner's journal/painpoints no longer leak into its ## Context section.

Still open: the PLANNER node has no preamble_allow_keys. Its ## Context section renders unfiltered — the implementer's implementation_summary, the latest journal payload (implementer painpoints after an implementer pass), and any future key another node starts writing all ride into planning. Input contract per the planner prompt should be: current_seed_id, current_seed_title, current_seed_brief (its own writes), review_verdict + review_feedback (reviewer bounce inputs). Verify against prompts/planner.md before setting; land as one attribute with a dated comment, same as the implementer fix. Delayed deliberately: one graph change at a time before the fib qualification runs (fabro-03ef verification), then close this.
